0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Suns visit the Trail Blazers in Portland. Phoenix is without Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery, and Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe, who is out following knee surgery, with ESPN's matchup predictor giving the Suns a 40% chance to win. The Suns won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but Portland beat them 92-77 in their most recent meeting, on February 22, 2026 in Phoenix.
